error.message: Vercel API response for GET /v1/billing/charges exceeded the 4194304-byte catalog limit. Split the range into adjacent UTC date windows using from (inclusive) and to (exclusive), down to one-day windows. Use each window's to as the next window's from to avoid gaps or double counting. Combine totals only after every window succeeds. If a one-day window still exceeds the limit, use a billing export outside this tool; do not retry the same range or report partial totals.
